**[P2] Do not schedule a stale snapshot after a reentrant state change**

A configurable content/result callback can synchronously call `on_operation_change` while `_emit` holds the reentrant lock. The inner call adopts and schedules the newer operation map, but this outer call then schedules its previously captured map afterward, displacing or following the newer record. Track a state revision when adopting operations and revalidate it before scheduling; add a test where a transform reenters `on_operation_change`.
